description.p: Omarchy Notes keeps rich notes in a local SQLite library, without an account.

ul.li: Rich writing, headings, lists, checklists, basic tables, images and attached files
Nested folders, pinning, prefix search and recoverable deletion
Quick Note and durable command-line capture
Portable import/export and verified library backups

description.p: The application retains its preview data directory. Legacy Qt libraries can be migrated from verified backup copies. Tags and Smart Folder interfaces are deferred; existing records remain preserved. Quotation libraries require the current app and returning to Qt uses a pre-upgrade backup.

Fix the installer/package-name mismatch with newly named omarchy-notes packages and archives. Complete the Rust-only Omarchy Notes branding cutover while retaining executable, app identity and data paths.
Version 1.0 release with rich writing, organization, recovery and data ownership workflows.
